assessment: This work combines a novel mouse model of inducible skeletal muscle specific deletion of Septin7 with Septin7 manipulation in vitro to explore the role of Septin7 in striated muscle development and function. The work should be of broad interest to muscle and cytoskeletal biologists as it indicates an essential role of Septin7 in normal muscle development and suggests potential roles in muscle regeneration as well.
